dct_description_sm: Georeferenced GeoTIFF raster dataset with 7,225 x 9,475 pixels and 4 bands. The raster uses the NAD83 / UTM zone 11N coordinate reference system (EPSG:26911). The source ZIP package contains the GeoTIFF and an auxiliary sidecar file.
gbl_displayNote_sm: A Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF derivative is available in addition to the original GeoTIFF package.
